## Objective
- Upgrade the existing canvas survival game “Nightfall” into an SCP-themed game with a closable/minimizable menu, richer graphics, enterable shelters, stronger SCP creatures, a 7th-night boss, region-changing chapters (e.g. Mexico, Japan), and a mobile-friendly mode.

## Requirements
- Menu must be able to be closed and minimized.
- Improve graphics: detailed map, creatures, shelters, main character, companions, textures, faces, and bodies.
- Creatures should be various SCP types and look like the SCPs they portray; they should be stronger.
- Main character must be able to enter shelters for protection from SCP creatures.
- 7th night must have a boss SCP to fight.
- Completing the 7th night completes the chapter and starts the next chapter in a different region (e.g. Mexico or Japan), with map style reflecting the region.
- Add a mode that enables gameplay on a mobile device and changes the layout to be mobile friendly.
- Build a complete, playable game; do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Save checks as small JPEG screenshots; only read the latest.

## Decisions
- Rewrote `index.html` completely to add menu window controls, mobile toggle, field guide, boss bar, chapter-complete overlay, safe/boss/mobile chips, pause controls, and new buttons.
- Chose 3 regions with 7-night chapters: `THE VALLEY` (USA), `SIERRA SOMBRA` (Mexico), `YUREI NO MORI` (Japan); SCP-682 is the boss on night 7 of every region.
- Planned SCP roster: SCP-173, SCP-096, SCP-106, SCP-049, SCP-939, SCP-610, SCP-457, plus boss SCP-682.
- Shelter entry gives protection while barricade integrity remains; SCPs target the wall instead of the player.
- Menu “minimize” and “close” hide the menu and show a `#menuDock` restore chip; pause has an equivalent `#pauseDock`.
- Mobile mode is a persistent toggle (`localStorage` key `nightfall.mobile.v1`) that adds `body.mobile-mode` and touch controls.
- Decided to fully rewrite `game.js` rather than patch the old 3571-line engine.
- Because the rewrite was too large for one tool call, split it into `game_part1.js`, `game_part2.js`, `game_part3.js` (and still needs parts 4–5), to be concatenated into `game.js`.

## Work State
### Completed

- Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
- Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
- After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.
